# New Cali Construction Inc.

> Culver City's top-rated remodeling contractor. Full-service design-build general contractor specializing in kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, ADU and garage conversions, and whole-home remodels across Culver City and the Westside of Los Angeles.

## Services

- **Kitchen Remodeling** - Full turnkey kitchen renovations, cabinet and countertop upgrades, layout changes, structural updates. Price range $15,000 - $100,000+. Typical timeline 2-10 weeks. See https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/kitchen.html
- **Bathroom Remodeling** - Guest bath refreshes to full master suite expansions, including plumbing, electrical, tile, fixtures. Price range $15,000 - $60,000+. Typical timeline 2-4 weeks for standard, 4-8 weeks for master suites. See https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/bathroom.html
- **ADU Construction & Garage Conversion** - End-to-end accessory dwelling unit construction and garage conversions including design, engineering, city permits, and build. Price range $80,000 - $180,000. Timeline 3-5 months. See https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/adu.html
- **Whole Home Remodeling** - Start-to-finish design-build whole-house renovations including demolition, framing, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, flooring, finishes. Price range $80,000 - $400,000+. Timeline 3-6 months. See https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/home-remodel.html
- **Fire Rebuild & Smoke Damage Restoration** - Ground-up rebuilds on total-loss lots, and renovation of homes that survived a fire but took smoke, soot and heat damage (insulation, ductwork, attic spaces, wall cavities). Includes insurance scope review, architect and engineer coordination, permitting, wildfire construction standards, and the build through final inspection. Scoped and quoted per property rather than per square foot. Most relevant to Pacific Palisades and Malibu after the January 2025 fire. See https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/fire-rebuild.html

## Service area

Culver City, Los Angeles, West LA, Santa Monica, Venice, Beverly Hills, Playa Vista, Mar Vista, Marina Del Rey, Inglewood, Malibu, Bel Air, Hawthorne, El Segundo, Westchester, Pacific Palisades, Mid City.

## Pricing tiers

- **Entry projects:** $15K - $40K (bathroom refreshes, kitchen upgrades, flooring, paint)
- **Signature projects:** $40K - $120K (full kitchen remodels, master bath renovations, room additions) - most common range
- **Premium projects:** $120K - $500K+ (whole home remodels, ADUs, multi-room design-build)

Every project begins with a free in-home consultation and a written line-item scope of work. The price is locked in writing before any work begins.

## The New Cali Promise (four-part guarantee, all in writing)

1. **We Show Up Day 1** - If the crew does not show up on the agreed start date, the homeowner owes us nothing. No deposit held, no questions asked.
2. **Written Scope Before We Touch Anything** - Every project starts with a detailed, line-item written scope of work signed by both parties before demolition begins.
3. **Weekly Photo Updates** - Homeowners receive progress photos every week, so they always know what is happening on the job site.
4. **On-Time, On-Budget - Or We Make It Right** - No surprise invoices, no scope creep without signed approval. If we go over on a locked item, that is on New Cali Construction, not the client.

## How the process works (four steps)

1. **You reach out** - Free, no-pressure contact via phone or form.
2. **We write a detailed scope** - The homeowner chooses whether to have an in-home visit or send photos and video of the space. Either way, a detailed line-item scope is written.
3. **You approve the price** - The price is locked in writing. No surprise invoices or unapproved scope changes.
4. **We build and keep you in the loop** - Day 1 start, weekly photo updates, delivered on time and on budget through the final walkthrough.

## Reference resource

- Westside LA permit-authority guide: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/permit-guide/ - a city-by-city table of WHICH agency reviews, permits and inspects a residential remodel across the Westside of Los Angeles, and which approvals stack on top. Culver City, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Malibu, El Segundo, Inglewood and Hawthorne are separately incorporated and each run their own building department. Marina del Rey is unincorporated LA County and permits through LA County Public Works. Venice, Pacific Palisades, West LA, Mar Vista, Playa Vista, Westchester, Mid City and Bel Air are City of Los Angeles and permit through LADBS. Note that Beverly Hills Post Office addresses are outside the city and permit through LADBS.

## Service-area pages (local detail per city: permitting authority, housing stock, local constraints)

- Culver City: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/culver-city/ - New Cali Construction's home city and headquarters (10000 Washington Blvd). Culver City is an independent municipality: permits, plan check and inspections go through the Culver City Building Safety Division under the Culver City Municipal Code, NOT LADBS, and Culver City has its own ADU ordinance layered over California state law. Housing stock spans 1920s-30s Spanish and traditional homes around Carlson Park, post-war tracts in Sunkist Park, Studio Village and McManus, hillside homes in Blair Hills and Culver Crest, and condos in Fox Hills.
- Santa Monica: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/santa-monica/ - independent city with its own Building and Safety Division inside its Community Development Department; permits and inspections run under the Santa Monica Municipal Code, NOT LADBS, and Santa Monica layers its own ADU requirements on top of California state law. Strong rent-control regime affects work on occupied or previously occupied units. Housing stock: 1920s Spanish and Craftsman bungalows in Ocean Park and the Pico district, mid-century homes in Sunset Park, larger traditionals north of Montana, condos through Wilshire-Montana and downtown.
- Venice: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/venice/ - City of Los Angeles, so LADBS issues the building permit, but almost all of Venice sits inside the Venice Coastal Zone. A Venice coastal development project must be cleared through City Planning under the Venice Coastal Zone Specific Plan before a demolition, grading or building permit will issue, and the California Coastal Commission can be involved on larger projects. In the coastal zone a project modifying no more than half the exterior walls is treated as a remodel; beyond that it can be reviewed as new development on a slower path. Narrow lots, walk streets and canal frontage make site access a design input.
- Mar Vista: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/mar-vista/ - post-war tract homes, LADBS permits, strong alley-garage ADU neighborhood.
- Playa Vista: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/playa-vista/ - condos and townhomes built 2002 onward, HOA architectural review plus LADBS permits.
- West LA: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/west-la/ - Sawtelle and Rancho Park homes plus condo corridors, LADBS permits.
- Marina del Rey: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/marina-del-rey/ - unincorporated LA County, permits via LA County Public Works, coastal zone, salt-air material specs.
- Beverly Hills: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/beverly-hills/ - City of Beverly Hills permits; Beverly Hills Post Office addresses permit through LADBS instead.
- Pacific Palisades: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/pacific-palisades/ - post-January-2025-fire. New Cali Construction takes on ground-up rebuilds on fire-affected lots (insurance scope review, architect and engineer coordination, soils, utilities, LADBS permitting, build through final inspection), smoke and heat damage renovation of homes that survived, ADUs on fire-affected parcels, and standard remodeling. Expedited rebuild permitting vs standard hillside and Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone process.
- Westchester: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/westchester/ - Kentwood and Osage tract homes, deep ADU-friendly lots, LAX soundproofing considerations.
- El Segundo: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/el-segundo/ - own city building department, small lots, coverage and parking constraints.
- Malibu: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/malibu/ - City of Malibu permits, coastal development permits, septic/OWTS capacity, fire-zone standards.
- Inglewood: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/inglewood/ - own city permits, 1920s period homes and multifamily/rental renovation work.
- Bel Air: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/bel-air/ - LADBS hillside review, canyon access constraints, private HOA/CC&R review.
- Hawthorne: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/hawthorne/ - own city permits, flat regular lots, strongest cost-per-square-foot ADU work.
- Mid City: https://www.newcaliconstruction.com/areas/mid-city/ - 1920s Spanish and Craftsman homes, HPOZ-adjacent blocks, LADBS permits.

## How New Cali Construction answers the top homeowner fears

- "Will the contractor disappear after I pay?" - Weekly photo updates and milestone-based payments. The crew is only paid as work is delivered. No deposit is held if the crew fails to show up on Day 1.
- "Will the price blow up mid-project?" - A written line-item scope with a locked price is signed before any work begins. Scope changes require the homeowner's signed approval. Overages on locked items are absorbed by New Cali Construction.
- "Can I trust this crew in my home?" - Fully licensed (California Contractor License #1008892), bonded, insured, and background-checked. Most of the crew has been with the company for years.
